correctness.rationale: The orthogonal joint projectors F_alpha sum to 1; u = sum F_alpha D_alpha has unit diagonal and satisfies F_alpha u = u D_alpha. Thus each fixed joint diagonal is exactly one simultaneous unit-conjugation orbit. Its diagonal stabilizer has arbitrary nonzero diagonal entries and arbitrary strict entries only at same-color comparable pairs. Dividing the orders gives q^d(c) over every finite field, also in characteristic two. The edge-weight expansion is the random-cluster sum on all comparable pairs, not just covers; positivity makes the degree and leading coefficient the maximum labeled Q-cut size and the number of maximizers. The argument includes edgeless posets and repeated coordinates. A fresh direct convolution census for q=k=2 gives 340 ordered pairs on the three-chain and 4132 on the diamond, with every individual diagonal fiber and the subset expansion agreeing. These are finite corroborations, not the proof. Replay: /workspace/branches/61009678-56b7-4d28-8c31-961d3dab9395/independent_counts.py.
